title: Flipkart GRiD 9.0
summary: Flipkart's engineering challenge with software development, AI engineering and data science tracks; national finals at Flipkart HQ, Bengaluru.
eligibility: Engineering students (BTech/BE/MTech/ME/MS, dual degree and integrated) at recognised Indian institutions, from the batches Flipkart specifies.

prize.description: Cash prizes and certificates (amount not published), plus SDE interview and internship pathways.

notes: GRiD 8.0 registered 19 June–7 July 2026; the link is the 8.0 listing. Expect 9.0 around June–July 2027.
